skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and retaining the denominator, including zero or improper numerator cases.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and convert fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Separate and combine mixed-number parts
skills.definition: For whole numbers or mixed numbers, separate whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts using implicit zero parts when needed, and recombine the final result while omitting zero parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or fractional part to lowest terms by canceling common factors.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator for unlike fractional parts and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts that already have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Work with whole parts in mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate, align missing parts as zero when needed, subtract whole-number parts, and combine whole and fractional parts into a mixed-number or integer result.

skills.name: Regroup or borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Borrow one or more wholes and add the corresponding denominator-over-denominator amount to the fractional part when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Reduce fractional result
skills.definition: Simplify a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including recognizing a zero fractional difference.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator, preferably the LCD, and convert unlike-denominator fractions or fraction parts to equivalent same-denominator fractions.

skills.name: Manage mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Rewrite whole numbers with zero fractional parts when needed, subtract whole-number parts separately, and recombine or remove zero whole/fraction parts in the final result.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes as denominator-sized fractional units when the minuend’s fractional part is too small to subtract directly.

skills.name: Reduce fractional result
skills.definition: Simplify a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator for unlike fractions and convert the fraction parts to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Handle whole-number and mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Separate, subtract, and recombine whole-number and fractional parts, including treating missing whole or fraction parts as zero.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing one or more wholes when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize the result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms or normalize zero fractional results to an integer form.

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and interpreting a zero numerator as 0.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractions and rewrite the fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Reduce fractional result
skills.definition: Simplify a nonzero fractional result or fractional part to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Decompose and recombine mixed or whole numbers
skills.definition: Separate operands that include whole-number parts, using 0 for missing whole or fraction parts, subtract whole parts, and recombine the whole and fractional results while omitting zero parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
